intent:
"yes approbe and begin the implementation" started the bstack build slice by slice, strictly one at a time ("keep it sequential"). Later: "i'm only not concerned about security hardening, threat-model concerns. Style and simplification and following proper design principles are still important." - build the full app fast, but review the core properly so slices and phases do not leave bugs.

The plans of record are in the repo: `docs/design.md` (requirements and decisions, including R24: licensing is out of scope) and `docs/implementation-plan.md` (tasks, task evidence contract). knowttl/bstack is public, has no GitHub Actions or workflows and no release automation, and ships through the no-mistakes pipeline (`.no-mistakes.yaml` owns the review budget and focus) with automatic merge of green work. Landed: Phase 0, T1.1 fixtures and T1.2 evaluation runner with the recorded, redacted baseline (https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/15). Baseline outcome without the skill: ambiguous-idea and clear-goals passed, new-idea failed.

This piece is slice C8: task T1.3 "Write the first SKILL.md" - a bounded, baseline-backed SKILL procedure (slice done evidence: gap map and package check, hard safeguards retained, unavailable later steps labelled).
amendments: First evidence-only commit 6778927 refreshed T1.2 against landed C7b revision 849d698b576edd75f40d626fb1395a65d337dba1 without new agent sessions.
Final implementation includes README usage, evaluation documentation and task progress before validation. This evidence-only commit records those actual runs.
Registered T1.3 reuses existing package-check and metadata suites. Natural-language effectiveness is reviewed against the baseline, not inferred from substring tests.

commands.reason: Optional generic validator does not accept the required multi-host frontmatter. The repo-specific package check verifies this contract.

cases.procedure: npm run check and the existing tests/scripts/package-check.test.mjs command-interface cases for valid packages, unavailable paths, missing metadata, nested or unlisted references and missing completion criteria, plus tests/scripts/skill-skeleton.test.mjs user-only metadata and local resource contract.

Review every new-idea failure and retain ambiguous-idea and clear-goals requirements against recorded T1.2 scoring citations, design AC-1, AC-2, AC-6, AC-9 and AC-38 and SKILL.md Steps 1, 2, 3, 7 and 8. The gap map proves mapping only.

Review scope, both checklists, review before apply, per-change AGENTS.md approval, protected writes, source-based verification, live probes, read-only research with fallback and unavailable tooling labels against T1.3 and design requirements.

limitations: No real agent sessions, with-skill comparison or ablation ran in C8. Recorded baselines stand and no advice was removed. Later checkpoints own agent execution.
References are placeholders and production helpers, board, protected writes and full paths remain unavailable as labelled. Package checks do not establish model interpretation.
Local automated checks ran on Node 24 and Linux only. Windows, macOS and other host behaviour are not established.

The optional skill-creator quick validator rejects the design-required disable-model-invocation field because its allowed metadata list lacks the multi-host setting. The repository package check is authoritative and passed with the hard user-only setting preserved.
